evidence.detail: post_rotation.py already calls set_legal_cards_async() and update_pd_legality_async() before rebuild_cache(), addressing the database side of the fix
legal_cards() reads from _cache_card WHERE pd_legal; only refreshes in-memory LEGAL_CARDS when len==0 or force=True
background_task_update_cards calls oracle.init(force=True) but NOT oracle.legal_cards(force=True), so in-memory LEGAL_CARDS stays stale after rotation even when card data refreshes
pd_legal in _cache_card is SUM(CASE WHEN cl.format_id = {current_season} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) — zero for all cards if new season's legality not yet populated

triage.fix_sketch: Add oracle.legal_cards(force=True) after oracle.init(force=True) at discordbot/background.py:135 so the in-memory legal cards list is refreshed whenever card data updates. Also verify that the bot skips serving requests during the rotation window (not just skipping db updates).
triage.notes: The database-side fix (post_rotation.py) is already in place. The residual issue is that the bot's in-memory LEGAL_CARDS list (oracle.py:15) does not get refreshed by the hourly card-update background task. Adding one oracle.legal_cards(force=True) call to background_task_update_cards would address this, but a race condition still exists if the bot calls legal_cards between rotation and post_rotation.py completing.
